title: Refund not paid after withdrawal
description: I withdrew my admission before the cut-off date but the institute has not refunded my fee after 4 months. The refund policy requires payment within 15 days and my emails to the accounts office have gone unanswered.

institution: greenfield institute of engineering and technology, hyderabad
title: Programme offered without AICTE approval
description: The institute is advertising a new programme and collecting fees although it has no approval from AICTE for it. Students are at risk of getting an invalid degree.

title: Capitation fee demanded during admission
description: The admission staff demanded a donation of two lakh rupees in cash for a seat, over and above the official fee. I have a recording of the conversation.

institution: Spelling does not matter when the ID is given
title: Laboratories without working equipment
description: Most laboratories have broken or missing equipment and the computer lab has about half the required systems. Students only watch demonstrations.

title: Faculty salaries unpaid for 5 months
description: Teaching staff have not received their salaries for five months and many are leaving. Classes are being cancelled as a result.
